content:
IDC today released a report pointing out that Huawei and Apple are the only smartphone manufacturers to record shipment growth in the Chinese market in the second quarter of 2026. Details are as follows.

This marks the fifth consecutive quarter of year-on-year decline.

The report shows that Apple recorded the strongest year-on-year shipment growth among major smartphone manufacturers in the Chinese market in the second quarter of 2026, reaching 24.4%.

Driven by this, Apple jumped from fifth to second place in ranking, with its market share climbing from 13.9% to 18.1%. Huawei maintained its market leadership, with smartphone shipments accounting for 22.6% during the period.

However, other major smartphone manufacturers all recorded year-on-year declines, with shipment drops reaching as much as 60.8%. Reasons include rising memory and component costs, the removal of government subsidies, and weakening consumer demand, particularly evident during the 618 shopping festival.

Overall, the Chinese smartphone market declined 4.3% year-on-year, with quarterly shipments of approximately 66 million units.
